Marta: Heads-up — QA found EU customers seeing dashboard cost widgets in USD instead of EUR. It looks like sample snippets in console docs always set currency: 'USD'.
Alex: ah yes, i hardcoded USD in the samples while testing. my bad. can we update examples + SDK snippets to show locale params?
Jordan: Would prefer to show example that detects locale from `accept-language` header and falls back to account currency. small snippet in Node + Python?
Sam: I can PR the Node snippet. quick patch: show two examples: explicit currency override and auto-detect. also need to check the dashboard sample rendering code for `formatCurrency` util.
DocsBot: Reminder: docs PRs must include unit tests for snippet output and add changelog entry. See <https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/CONTRIBUTING.md>
Alex: here's a proposed Node snippet:
```js
const fmt = new CurrencyFormatter({locale: 'de-DE'});
console.log(fmt.format(1234.56, {currency: 'EUR'})) // => "1.234,56 €"
```
Is that too JS-y?
Jordan: looks fine. For Python:
```py
from redwood import CurrencyFormatter
fmt = CurrencyFormatter(locale='fr-FR')
print(fmt.format(1234.56, currency='EUR'))  # 1 234,56 €
```
Sam: I'll open PR: #4123. tagging @Marta for test vectors. also need to fix a broken docs link in dashboard embed (line ~42) that points to old SDK path.
Marta: thanks. QA: please add a test that verifies currency symbol + thousands separators for en-US, de-DE, fr-FR. Also add a tiny note in migration guide about legacy templates that assumed USD.
QA: We found one edgecase: pre-existing saved widgets store `currency=null`, dashboard rendering defaults to USD. Should change default to tenant currency if present. filing bug in infra.
Alex: created PR draft https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 — includes Node + Python snippets, updated dashboard example, and fixed link to SDK reference.
Jordan: I'll review later today. @Sam please attach the failing widget id for QA to test.
Sam: attaching widget id 0x9f3a in PR description. also updated sample screenshot (embedded).
DocsBot: CI docs-lint passed, snippet-tests failing on spacing — rerun after fix.
